name: myagevolt-db-dev-copilot
description: AgeVolt plugin pre databazovu pracu na MyAgeVolt cez database repo: MySQL rutiny, schema/export lookup, vykonova diagnostika, OCPP RAW/davkovy tok, DataGrid DB kontrakty a branch/diff workflow.

interface.longDescription: Databazovy pomocnik pre MyAgeVolt portal. Pouziva lokalny AgeVolt database repo ako primarny pracovny zdroj pre schemu, exporty, knowledge_base, changelog a branch/diff workflow. Legacy kontext z ChatGPT projektu triggers cistenie ostava pouzitelny, ale pri konflikte maju vzdy prioritu database/AGENTS.md a database/knowledge_base. Plugin neobsahuje raw DB exporty, produkcne logy ani zakaznicke data.
defaultPrompt: Najdi MyAgeVolt DB objekt v database repo a priprav branch + diff.
Skontroluj pomaly dotaz proti database exportom a metadata.
Priprav DB zmenu ako changelog kandidat bez DB apply.
